faqs.question: How long does a garage door typically last?
faqs.answer: Most garage doors in North Texas last 15–30 years, depending on usage, climate exposure, door quality, and maintenance. Regular tune-ups and properly matched components can significantly extend lifespan.

faqs.question: How often should a garage door be serviced?
faqs.answer: For most residential doors, once per year is recommended. Heavily used doors or commercial systems may need more frequent service to maintain safe operation.

faqs.question: Why is my garage door loud or shaky?
faqs.answer: Noise is commonly caused by worn rollers, dry hinges, loose hardware, misaligned tracks, or an aging opener. In many cases, a professional tune-up or roller upgrade can dramatically reduce noise.

faqs.question: Is it safe to use a garage door that isn't working properly?
faqs.answer: No. If your door is crooked, jerky, unusually loud, or struggling to open, continued use can cause further damage or create a safety hazard. We recommend stopping use and scheduling professional service.

faqs.question: How do I know if my garage door spring is broken?
faqs.answer: Common signs include a garage door that won’t open, opens only a few inches, feels extremely heavy, or makes a loud bang when it fails. You may also see a visible gap in the spring above the door. If you notice any of these symptoms, stop using the door and contact a professional.

faqs.question: Can I open my garage door with a broken spring?
faqs.answer: It’s not recommended. A broken spring puts excessive strain on the opener and can cause further damage or serious injury. In most cases, the door is unsafe to lift manually without proper equipment and training.

faqs.question: How long does garage door spring repair take?
faqs.answer: Most broken spring repairs are completed in under one hour. Our technicians carry the proper tools and replacement springs to restore safe operation during the same visit.

faqs.question: Do both garage door springs need to be replaced?
faqs.answer: If your door uses two springs, replacing both at the same time is strongly recommended. Springs wear evenly, and replacing only one often leads to imbalance and another failure shortly after.

faqs.question: What type of garage door springs do you replace?
faqs.answer: We replace both torsion and extension springs for residential and commercial garage doors. All replacements use manufacturer-approved springs designed for long-term reliability.

faqs.question: Is broken garage door spring repair dangerous?
faqs.answer: Yes. Garage door springs are under extreme tension and can cause serious injury if handled improperly. Spring repair should only be performed by trained professionals with the correct tools and experience.

faqs.question: Will my garage door opener be damaged if I keep using it with a broken spring?
faqs.answer: Yes. Operating a garage door with a broken spring places extreme strain on the opener and can cause motor, gear, or rail failure. We recommend stopping use immediately and scheduling professional repair.

faqs.question: How much does broken spring repair cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the size, type, and weight of the garage door, as well as the number of springs required. Garage Cowboy provides clear, upfront pricing before any work begins—no hidden fees.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency garage door spring repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide after-hours emergency broken spring repair throughout DFW at no additional charge, so you’re never stuck with a door you can’t safely use.

faqs.question: How do I know if my garage door opener needs repair or replacement?
faqs.answer: If your opener is unresponsive, makes grinding or clicking noises, reverses unexpectedly, or struggles to lift the door, it may need repair. If the opener is older, lacks modern safety features, or fails repeatedly, replacement is often the better long-term option.

faqs.question: Can you repair my existing garage door opener?
faqs.answer: Yes. We repair most opener issues, including motor problems, worn gears, sensor alignment issues, wiring faults, and remote or wall control failures. We always recommend repair when it’s safe and cost-effective.

faqs.question: What brands of garage door openers do you service?
faqs.answer: We service all major garage door opener brands, including LiftMaster, Genie, Chamberlain, and Craftsman, for both residential and commercial systems.

faqs.question: How long does opener repair or installation take?
faqs.answer: Most opener repairs are completed in under one hour. New opener installations typically take one to two hours, depending on the system type and any required upgrades.

faqs.question: Do you install smart garage door openers?
faqs.answer: Yes. We install smart garage door openers with Wi-Fi connectivity, smartphone control, real-time alerts, and enhanced security features. We’ll help you choose the right opener based on door size, usage, and noise preferences.

faqs.question: Why is my garage door opener running but the door not moving?
faqs.answer: This often indicates a broken spring, disconnected trolley, or internal gear failure. Continuing to run the opener can cause further damage. Our technicians can identify the cause and restore safe operation.

faqs.question: Are garage door openers safe to repair myself?
faqs.answer: Garage door opener systems involve electrical components and interact with high-tension door hardware. Improper repairs can cause injury or additional damage. Professional service is recommended.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency garage door opener repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide after-hours emergency garage door opener repair throughout the DFW area at no additional charge.

faqs.question: Will a new opener work with my existing garage door?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. We properly match the opener to your garage door’s weight, size, and configuration and make all necessary adjustments for safe operation.

faqs.question: What happens when a garage door cable breaks?
faqs.answer: When a garage cable breaks, the garage door may lift unevenly, jam, or suddenly drop. Because cables support the full weight of the door, failure creates a serious safety risk and should be addressed with professional garage door repair immediately.

faqs.question: Is it dangerous to use my garage door with a broken cable or drum?
faqs.answer: Yes. Operating a door with damaged cables or drums can cause the door to fall, bend tracks, break rollers, or damage the opener. Stop using the door and contact a professional.

faqs.question: What causes garage door cables or drums to fail?
faqs.answer: Common causes include normal wear, rust or corrosion, improper tension, worn springs, misaligned tracks, and impact damage. Drums can also wear over time, allowing cables to slip.

faqs.question: Can a broken garage door cable be repaired, or does it need replacement?
faqs.answer: Cables are not safely repairable once damaged. Frayed or broken cables should always be replaced to ensure safe operation.

faqs.question: Do both garage door cables need to be replaced at the same time?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. Cables wear evenly, and replacing both helps maintain balance and reduce the risk of another failure.

faqs.question: How long does cable or drum repair take?
faqs.answer: Most cable and drum repairs can be completed in a single visit once the door is safely secured. Timing depends on door size and any additional damage found.

faqs.question: Will you replace the drums if they are worn or damaged?
faqs.answer: Yes. If drums show signs of wear, cracking, or cable slippage, we replace them with properly sized, manufacturer-approved drums.

faqs.question: Can a broken cable damage my garage door opener?
faqs.answer: Yes. An opener attempting to lift a door with failed cables or drums can burn out gears or bend the rail. Turning off the opener until repairs are made is often the safest option.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day garage cable repair in DFW?
faqs.answer: Yes. Same-day garage cable repair is available when possible across the Dallas–Fort Worth area, including Arlington, Dallas, Keller, Mansfield, and nearby cities.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency garage door cable repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer after-hours emergency service at no additional charge because cable and drum failures can pose serious safety and security risks.

faqs.question: What should I do if my garage door is off track?
faqs.answer: Stop using the door and opener immediately. Operating a crooked or jammed door can cause more damage or create a serious safety hazard. Keep people and pets away and call a professional.

faqs.question: Is an off-track garage door dangerous?
faqs.answer: Yes. An off-track door can shift suddenly or fall, especially if cables or rollers are compromised. It can also overload the opener and cause additional failures.

faqs.question: What causes a garage door to come off its tracks?
faqs.answer: Common causes include worn rollers, loose track hardware, track misalignment, impact damage, frayed or broken cables, and bracket or hinge failure.

faqs.question: Can I fix an off-track garage door myself?
faqs.answer: It’s not recommended. Garage doors are heavy and can be under high tension. Attempting to reset the door without proper tools and training can lead to injury or further damage.

faqs.question: How long does off-track garage door repair take?
faqs.answer: Many off-track repairs can be completed in a single visit once the door is secured and the cause is identified. If parts are needed, we explain options and timing up front.

faqs.question: Will an off-track door damage my opener?
faqs.answer: Yes. Continued operation can burn out gears, bend the rail, or damage internal components. Turning the opener off is usually the safest option.

faqs.question: Do you replace bent tracks or just realign them?
faqs.answer: Minor misalignment can often be corrected. If tracks are bent, kinked, or unsafe, replacing affected sections is typically the best long-term solution.

faqs.question: What are signs my garage door may come off track again?
faqs.answer: Grinding noises, uneven movement, wobbling, visible roller wear, loose track bolts, or a door that appears crooked are all warning signs.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day off-track repair in DFW?
faqs.answer: Yes. Same-day service is available when possible across the Dallas–Fort Worth area, including Arlington, Dallas, Keller, Mansfield, and nearby cities.

faqs.question: Do you offer after-hours emergency off-track repair?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide after-hours emergency service at no additional charge because off-track doors often present safety and security concerns.

faqs.question: What do garage door rollers do?
faqs.answer: Garage door rollers guide the door along the tracks and allow smooth, even movement during opening and closing. Worn rollers can cause noise, shaking, and alignment issues.

faqs.question: How do I know if my garage door rollers need to be replaced?
faqs.answer: Common signs include loud squeaking or grinding noises, jerky or uneven movement, visible cracks or flat spots on rollers, or a door that wobbles or rubs the tracks.

faqs.question: What types of garage door rollers do you replace?
faqs.answer: We replace standard steel rollers, plastic rollers, and offer nylon roller upgrades for quieter operation and longer lifespan.

faqs.question: Are nylon garage door rollers better than steel rollers?
faqs.answer: For most residential doors, nylon rollers are quieter and require less maintenance than steel rollers. Steel rollers may still be appropriate for certain heavy-duty or commercial doors.

faqs.question: How long does roller replacement take?
faqs.answer: Most roller replacements can be completed in under an hour, depending on the door size and number of rollers being replaced.

faqs.question: Can worn rollers damage other parts of my garage door?
faqs.answer: Yes. Worn or seized rollers can cause track wear, door misalignment, and increased strain on the opener, potentially leading to more costly repairs.

faqs.question: Do all garage door rollers need to be replaced at the same time?
faqs.answer: It’s often recommended to replace all rollers at once to ensure even movement and prevent uneven wear or repeat service calls.

faqs.question: Is garage door roller replacement safe to do myself?
faqs.answer: Some rollers are under spring tension, and improper replacement can be dangerous. Professional service is recommended to ensure safe handling and correct installation.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day roller replacement across DFW?
faqs.answer: Yes. Same-day service is available when possible throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex.

faqs.question: Can roller replacement make my garage door quieter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upgrading to high-quality nylon rollers often significantly reduces noise, vibration, and rattling during operation.

faqs.question: Why isn’t my garage door remote or keypad working?
faqs.answer: Common causes include dead batteries, lost programming, opener memory issues, signal interference, or a remote or keypad that’s no longer compatible with the opener.

faqs.question: Can you program a new garage door remote or keypad?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can program new remotes and wireless keypads to most garage door openers, including pairing multiple devices and clearing old codes if needed.

faqs.question: What brands of garage door openers do you work with?
faqs.answer: We service and program remotes and keypads for all major opener brands, including LiftMaster, Genie, Chamberlain, and Craftsman.

faqs.question: Can you erase old or lost remotes from my opener?
faqs.answer: Yes. If a remote is lost or stolen, we can clear the opener’s memory and reprogram authorized remotes and keypads to restore security.

faqs.question: Do you program in-car garage door buttons (Homelink)?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can pair vehicle-based systems such as Homelink with compatible garage door openers and troubleshoot pairing issues.

faqs.question: How long does remote or keypad programming take?
faqs.answer: Most programming services take only a few minutes once compatibility is confirmed. Full system resets may take slightly longer.

faqs.question: Is garage door remote programming secure?
faqs.answer: Yes. Modern garage door systems use rolling-code technology. Proper programming ensures secure communication and prevents unauthorized access.

faqs.question: Do I need a new opener if my remote won’t program?
faqs.answer: Not usually. In most cases, the issue lies with the remote, keypad, or programming process—not the opener itself.

faqs.question: Can you program multiple remotes or keypads during one visit?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can program multiple remotes, keypads, and vehicle buttons during a single service visit.

faqs.question: What is included in a garage door maintenance or tune-up service?
faqs.answer: A professional tune-up includes a full inspection of springs, cables, rollers, tracks, hinges, and hardware; lubrication of moving parts; door balance and tension checks; opener force and limit testing; safety sensor alignment; and identification of worn or failing components.

faqs.question: How often should a garage door be serviced?
faqs.answer: Most garage doors should be professionally serviced once per year. Doors with heavy daily use or commercial doors may benefit from more frequent maintenance.

faqs.question: Why is garage door maintenance important?
faqs.answer: Routine maintenance helps prevent unexpected breakdowns, improves safety, reduces noise, and extends the life of both the garage door and opener by catching small issues early—avoiding the need for emergency garage door repair.

faqs.question: Can a tune-up prevent broken springs or cables?
faqs.answer: While maintenance can’t stop normal wear entirely, regular tune-ups can identify early signs of spring fatigue, cable fraying, or hardware wear—reducing the risk of sudden failure.

faqs.question: Is garage door maintenance worth it if my door seems to work fine?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many garage door failures occur without warning. Preventative maintenance helps ensure safe operation and can save money by avoiding emergency repairs.

faqs.question: How long does a garage door tune-up take?
faqs.answer: Most maintenance visits take less than an hour, depending on the size and condition of the door and opener.

faqs.question: Do you service both residential and commercial garage doors?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance and tune-ups for both residential and commercial garage door systems throughout the DFW area.

faqs.question: Will you tell me if parts need to be replaced during maintenance?
faqs.answer: Yes. If worn or failing components are found, we’ll explain the issue and provide clear options before any additional work is done.

faqs.question: Can garage door maintenance reduce noise?
faqs.answer: Yes. Proper lubrication, tightening of hardware, and alignment adjustments often significantly reduce squeaking, grinding, and rattling noises.

faqs.answer: Yes. We provide garage door maintenance and tune-ups throughout the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex, including Fort Worth, Arlington, Dallas, Keller, Mansfield, and nearby areas.
